raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The published Kimi-K3 DFLASH recipes with DCP, such as TP8 DCP8 on B300, stop at CUDA graph capture on main, so the server does not start.

This hits DFLASH users on all 13 cookbook DCP cells that offer it (B300, GB300, GB200, and B200 Decode).

The published DFLASH flags fail this way at TP4 DCP4 on 4 B200 GPUs with a reduced K3 config and dummy weights. At TP8 and TP16, only the resolver ran: `prefill` on main, `decode` with this change.

Under DCP, the K3 override sets `speculative_attention_mode` to `decode` only for DSPARK. DFLASH stays on `prefill`, so target verify runs on `trtllm_mla`, which refuses this path:

```
trtllm_mla cannot forward a global causal bound to its decode kernel, which is required for DCP with q_len > 1 (speculative target-verify / draft-extend); select cutedsl_mla for a DCP speculative run
```

Explicit `--speculative-attention-mode decode` avoids this, but no published command sets it.

We found no open PR that fixes this: #43599 covers EAGLE3 only, and #47142 reports DFLASH at TP8 DCP8 on GB300 without changing this override or showing a mode flag.

## Modifications

On the K3 DCP override's `cutedsl_mla` path, DFLASH now resolves the mode to `decode`, as DSPARK does. Recipe flags, AITER, and NPU paths do not change.

An explicit `--speculative-attention-mode prefill` now becomes `decode` with no log line, as for DSPARK. Lower-case `dflash` still fails at capture.

## Accuracy Tests

Servers used the Motivation setup, so accuracy and acceptance were not measured.

- The PD decode role (fake transfer backend) failed the same way on main. With the fix, it and the published flags run verify. Published-flag tokens and logprobs match main with explicit `decode`.
- With a local patch that drafts the NOSPEC continuation, logprobs over the matching token prefix stayed within 0.002 of NOSPEC at dummy range +/-0.05. A verify causal bound smaller by one raised that to 0.023. Near-uniform logits make tokens diverge after that prefix.

Not checked: B300, GB200, GB300, multi-node runs, a real PD transfer, HiCache, AITER, NPU, `--enable-unified-memory`, and a server run on current main.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not measured. A PD prefill role with `--dcp-size` above 1 also moves to `decode`. It does not verify, and a fake-transfer check kept its first token and logprob.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -182,7 +182,7 @@ Speculation: DSPARK holds block size + 1 (= 8) intermediate states per request 
 
 **MoE runner.** Leave `--moe-runner-backend` unset on Blackwell: FlashInfer MXFP4 (W4A8, official trtllm-gen SiTU kernels) is selected; H100/H200 pin Marlin. The B200 Balanced and High-Throughput cells pin `flashinfer_mxfp4` explicitly because that is the shape they were brought up on.
 
-**Attention backend.** Leave all three attention knobs unset on Blackwell: K3 resolves prefill, decode, and — under DSPARK — verification as a set (`trtllm_mla` across the board; `cutedsl_mla` takes decode and verification under DCP). On the non-DCP recipes, setting any one of the three cancels the auto-resolution for the others. The B200 Balanced and High-Throughput cells pin `--decode-attention-backend cutedsl_mla`, which is what auto-resolution picks for those DCP recipes anyway — it is written out because it is the shape they were brought up on, not because it changes the resolution. H100/H200 pin `flashmla` for decode.
+**Attention backend.** Leave all three attention knobs unset on Blackwell: K3 resolves prefill, decode, and — under DSPARK, and under DFLASH on the DCP recipes — verification as a set (`trtllm_mla` across the board; `cutedsl_mla` takes decode and verification under DCP). On the non-DCP recipes, setting any one of the three cancels the auto-resolution for the others. The B200 Balanced and High-Throughput cells pin `--decode-attention-backend cutedsl_mla`, which is what auto-resolution picks for those DCP recipes anyway — it is written out because it is the shape they were brought up on, not because it changes the resolution. H100/H200 pin `flashmla` for decode.
 
 **Context length.** `--context-length` bounds the longest accepted request plus some context-scaled buffers; it does not size the KV pool. For long context the lever that adds capacity is `fp8_e4m3` KV.

@@ -99,6 +99,10 @@ def _kimi_k3_overrides(server_args: Any, hf_config: Any) -> dict:
                 prefill_attention_backend="trtllm_mla",
                 decode_attention_backend="cutedsl_mla",
             )
+            if cfg.speculative_algorithm == "DFLASH":
+                # trtllm_mla refuses DCP target verify, so verify must run on
+                # the cutedsl_mla decode backend, same as DSPARK above.
+                overrides["speculative_attention_mode"] = "decode"
         elif decode_backend == "aiter":
             _require_kimi_k3_aiter_gluon_dcp_support()
             # Override prefill backend to aiter by default

@@ -119,11 +119,12 @@ def test_kimi_k3_dspark_override_verifies_on_the_decode_backend(self):
             algorithm="DSPARK",
         )
 
-    def test_kimi_k3_dflash_keeps_prefill_mode_and_is_refused(self):
-        mode = _kimi_k3_mode("DFLASH")
-        self.assertEqual(mode, "prefill")
-        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "TRTLLMMLABackend"):
-            _require(_hybrid(TRTLLMMLABackend, CuteDslMLABackend, mode), mode=mode)
+    def test_kimi_k3_dflash_override_verifies_on_the_decode_backend(self):
+        self.assertEqual(_kimi_k3_mode("DFLASH"), "decode")
+        _require(
+            _hybrid(TRTLLMMLABackend, CuteDslMLABackend, _kimi_k3_mode("DFLASH")),
+            mode="decode",
+        )
 
     def test_only_unified_dcp_speculative_runs_are_checked(self):
         hybrid = _hybrid(TRTLLMMLABackend, CuteDslMLABackend, "prefill")
